The Circosta Law Firm assists companies and individuals across the Americas with international contracts, corporate and commercial law, compliance, arbitration and dispute resolution, with strategies tailored to operations between the Americas and Europe.

North America

Central and South America

In Central and South America we support companies bridging Latin American markets with Europe. Countries where we operate:

  • Argentina
  • Brazil
  • Chile
  • Colombia
  • Mexico
  • Panama
